svg.text: Nasdaq 100 index: every decline from a record high — how deep, and how long until a NEW RECORD
319 declines 1985–2026, record to lowest low before the next record · green = new record · red ring = not yet · line = middle wait, at least this deep
decline, record to low (%, log scale; under 0.3% drawn at 0.3%)
sessions from the low to a new record (log)

2021-11 record: -37.7%, 297 sessions to a new record
